title: Northgate Optical Lab Schedule: Material Surcharge on Accidental Replacements
content:
An accidental damage replacement of Northgate Optical eyewear made in an upgraded lens material carries a replacement material surcharge.

**Schedule.** Where the job's lens material is a 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index material and a material upgrade charge stands on the original job, net of credits against it, a replacement material surcharge of 25.00 is added; where the material is polycarbonate or Trivex and such a charge stands, the replacement material surcharge is 10.00. Standard plastic, or a material upgrade charge credited down to nothing, carries no surcharge.

| Lens material on the job | Net material upgrade charge on the original job | Replacement material surcharge |
|---|---|---|
| 1.60, 1.67 or 1.74 high index | above zero | 25.00 |
| polycarbonate or Trivex | above zero | 10.00 |
| any | zero or none posted | none |
| standard plastic | — | none |

**Net material upgrade charge.** The material upgrade charge of the original job (remake number 0), less every credit posted against material upgrade charges of the job. The surcharge is a flat amount; it does not depend on the size of that net charge, only on whether it stands.

### Examples (hypothetical jobs)

- 1.74 high index, material upgrade charge 120.00, no credits: 25.00.
- Trivex, material upgrade charge 38.25 after a Plus discount: 10.00.
- Polycarbonate, material upgrade charge 30.00 fully refunded: none.
